title: What Is Biology Really About? Explained Simply | PUC Biology Class 11
description:
A mango, a bowl of curd and your own hand look nothing alike, yet all three are full of living cells. Diya wants to be a doctor and asks the big question: what is biology really about? This first lesson of PUC Biology (Class 11) gives you the basic idea of the whole subject before any chapter begins.

You will see what the word biology means and its main branches (botany, zoology, microbiology, physiology, genetics, ecology). A live zoom ladder takes one mango leaf down to its tissues, one cell, a chloroplast and a chlorophyll molecule, with every part labelled. We build the levels of organisation from molecule to ecosystem, meet the cell theory (Schleiden 1838, Schwann 1839, Virchow 1855), compare an amoeba with your trillions of cells, see why living things are classified and named (Mangifera indica, Homo sapiens), and walk through the map of all ten PUC Biology units. Then a worked example, the exam trap about the cell, an original NEET pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and NEET students.
